result.summary: The image shows a wide, signalized intersection in a residential area with multiple travel lanes and long crossing distances. While marked crosswalks and sidewalks are present, the lack of pedestrian refuge islands and the overall scale of the roadway prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a safe place to stop.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There is no median or refuge island to protect pedestrians who cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing transverse markings to continental or ladder style for better driver awareness.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with long pedestrian crossing distances and faded pavement markings. While sidewalks are present on one side, the lack of protective infrastructure like refuge islands or high-visibility crossings creates a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: Existing crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder style crosswalk markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a residential area with marked continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the left side of the image may obstruct the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway, adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk with ADA-compliant curb ramps and tactile paving, serving a multi-story residential building. However, the signalized crossing lacks visible pedestrian-specific signal heads, and the wide roadway geometry lacks traffic calming features to manage vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads, creating uncertainty for people crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: On the signal poles at the intersection corners

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The corner design allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground corner where the sidewalk meets the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.
